name: SONG_demo1
texts:
[[A0]]
[5.7:] What heaven has raised,
[11.3:] Let no hand bring down.
[[B1]]
[22.6:] Petals hang up there like they forgot the ground,
[28.2:] Down here the water's shaking in the bowl.
[33.9:] You pressed your stars in wax and didn't look;
[39.5:] We felt it in our backs before the toll.
[[C2]]
[45.2:] Every bell you lift into the light,
[50.8:] Somewhere a mountain —
[[D3]]
[56.5:] We built it wide, we built it low,
[62.1:] We learned to walk the way you lean;
[67.8:] Eight hundred years we held the shade
[73.4:] Of gardens we have never seen.
[79.1:] (Hold it up) we held it up,
[81.9:] (hold it up) we held it up.
[[E4]]
[90.3:] Open the doors (open the doors),
[93.2:] Light every lamp (light every lamp),
[96.0:] Count every road, count every bed,
[98.8:] Raise up your hand —
[[F5]]
[112.9:] Let no hand bring down
[118.6:] What heaven raised so high,
[124.2:] A thousand ships, a thousand guns,
[129.9:] All waiting on one sign —
[135.5:] Let no hand —
[[F6]]
[146.8:] Then let it come down,
[152.5:] A hand's breadth at a time;
[158.1:] Lay down the gold, lay down the guns,
[163.8:] Let every anchor sound.
[[G7]]
[169.4:] Come down, come down,
[172.2:] We would have you come down.
[175.1:] Come down, come down —
